newsitem.title: USA: New York governor in minor auto accident.
newsitem.headline: New York governor in minor auto accident.

text.p: A vehicle carrying New York Gov. George Pataki was involved Monday in a minor traffic accident that resulted in no injuries, a spokesman said.
Pataki was riding in the front passenger seat of a state-owned vehicle when it was struck broadside on the driver's side by a refrigerated truck, the governor's spokesman said.
The accident occurred in the state capital of Albany when the truck failed to stop at a flashing red light. The governor was taken to a nearby hospital where he was checked for injuries and released.
